title: fix(objectql,driver-sql): the tenant-audit warning skips an insert whose rows carry their organization, and the engine declares the D8 wall-exemption to the driver
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7XX31HkENJWqk9mfoyv6Mw)_

Fixes #25230
Part of #15212

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Diagnostics only. No write changes: no statement, scope, row or refusal moves. The `[tenant-audit]` prefix and text are byte-identical.

1. **driver-sql: an insert whose rows carry their organization is not audited.** `SqlDriver.auditMissingTenant` takes the inserted rows from the two insert doors (`create`, `bulkCreate`). When every row carries a non-empty tenant column (empty is spelled as `injectTenantOnInsert` spells it), the line is skipped: an insert is confined to the organizations its rows name. One row without the column keeps the line. `update`, `delete`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`, `bulkDelete` and `upsert` with no `tenantId` still warn, whatever the payload says. For an update or delete the column is a value being written, not the scope, and an upsert's merge leg can reach another organization's row.
2. **objectql: the engine declares the D8 wall-exemption to the driver.** `buildDriverOptions` fills in `bypassTenantAudit: true` when the Layer 0 verdict that plugin-security recorded on the operation is `none` and the engine's own fallback asking of the same ladder (`computeTenantLayer0Verdict` with the exemption withheld, the scope an unrecorded operation already gets) would have walled it. This is plugin-security's own `crossedByPlatformAdmin` test, read from the recorded value. It is the existing option, so there is no `DriverOptions` widening and no new `OperationContext` member, and the driver reads no posture it did not read before. It is not filled in when no verdict was recorded (a by-id write, a system context, no security layer), under `single`, for an insert (write target), for an object outside the tenant machinery (tenancy-disabled, federated, no tenant field), for a verdict that does not parse, or when the caller supplied its own value.

Other drivers: Turso's local face and the SQLite WASM driver inherit `SqlDriver.create` / `bulkCreate`, so they get (1). Turso's remote face never called the audit. `driver-memory` and `driver-mongodb` have no tenant-audit warning.

## Measured: a walled `os serve` boot, before and after

Setup (as on #25210's R4): `pnpm dev -- --fresh` on the showcase with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, a 32-byte `OS_SECRET_KEY`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only` and `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`. `@objectstack/organizations` was declared in the showcase's `package.json` and linked for the run only; both were reverted and are not in this diff. Health 200 both times; 20 s settle after health; seeded admin sign-up included.

| `[tenant-audit]` lines | base `0f1eeeeeb` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | 16 (2 `showcase_*`, 14 `sys_*`) | **0** |
| `bulkCreate` | 16 (all `showcase_*`) | **0** |
| `update` | 5 | 5 |
| `updateMany` | 18 | 18 |
| **total** | **55** | **23** |

Every insert line is gone; every update and updateMany line stays, as the card requires.

## Tests

- `sql-driver-tenant-audit-insert-carries-tenant.test.ts` (new, real `SqlDriver` on in-memory SQLite, 11 tests). Pins: `create` and `bulkCreate` whose rows carry the organization print nothing. Controls: a row without it, an empty organization, one row of a batch without it, and the byte-identical prefix all still warn; `update` (payload naming an organization), `delete`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany` and `upsert` (row naming an organization) all still warn.
- `engine-tenant-audit-wall-exemption.test.ts` (new, the `DriverOptions` seam and harness of `engine-driver-read-scope.test.ts`, 10 tests). Declared: recorded `none` under `isolated` on `updateMany` and `deleteMany`, and under `group`. Not declared: a walled verdict, no recorded verdict, `single`, an insert, a tenancy-disabled object, an unparseable verdict, a caller's own `bypassTenantAudit: false`.
- Two existing driver pins used a `create` whose row carried `organization_id` as the "write without tenant" shape: `sql-driver-tenant-audit-posture.test.ts` now uses a `delete` for that helper (and its `bypassTenantAudit` case), and `sql-driver-tenant-scope.test.ts`'s throttle pin now uses two deletes. Their assertions are unchanged.
- Package suites: `@objectstack/objectql` test 464 files, 8686 passed; typecheck exit 0. `@objectstack/driver-sql` typecheck exit 0; test 3773 passed, 1 failed on the first run (the throttle pin above, which encoded the old insert behaviour), and the fixed file passes 61/61 with its two sibling audit files. Cross-package readers of the prefix: `service-messaging` `delivery-claim-tenant-audit` and `delivery-update-tenant-audit` integration tests 13/13; `service-storage` `tenant-audit-update-delete-half-repairs` 30/30.

## Ablation

Both run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the fix committed, and each restore was verified (blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import source, so no build leg is needed.

- Deleted the row-carries-tenant skip in `auditMissingTenant`: the 2 insert pins go red and the 9 controls stay green (2 failed, 9 passed).
- Removed the engine's `opts.bypassTenantAudit = true` for the exemption: the 3 "declared" pins go red and the 7 "not declared" stay green (3 failed, 7 passed). My first attempt was refused by the tool before running anything, because the replacement text was a substring of the anchor. The second attempt used a distinct replacement.

## Gates

Run on the final head `d323330402`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 74 commands over 8 changed paths. I ran each one and captured its exit code before any pipe: **74/74 exit 0**. `--ran` reports "74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Two shallow-clone prerequisites were met first, by fetching `621a48760` (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`) and running `--shallow-since=2026-07-17` (`check-engine-split-ratio --days 90`). On the earlier head `b57e83d5`, the same 72 were green and those two exited 3 and 2 on the shallow clone. CI runs everything else; this PR does not touch a governed surface.

## Acceptance notes

- The 23 lines left at a walled boot are seed-time `update` and `updateMany` on `showcase_*` objects with no `tenantId`. That is the case the line exists for, and the card keeps it. Whether the showcase seed path should run those writes in an organization's context is outside this card. I'm noting it here and not filing it, since nothing is shown wrong.
- An exempt admin's **by-id** write records no verdict, so the engine scopes it by its own facts (the active organization), and nothing is declared. Only predicate writes carry the recorded `none`. This is ADR-0131 D8 as written; this PR does not move it.
- I did not exercise the exemption end to end through REST. It is pinned at the `DriverOptions` seam, where plugin-security's recorded verdict meets the engine. Boundary: `NOT MEASURED: live exempt-admin predicate write`.
